comment: Curated recognizable-star tier list. fame: 3 = instantly recognizable to anyone, 2 = recognizable to NBA fans, 1 = recognizable to heads. signature feeds key-play descriptions and (later) image prompts.

michael-jordan.signature: rising fadeaway from the elbow, tongue out

lebron-james.signature: freight-train chase-down block and tomahawk slam

magic-johnson.signature: no-look dime on the break, smiling

larry-bird.signature: step-back three, walking away before it drops

kevin-durant.signature: effortless pull-up jumper from the wing

giannis-antetokounmpo.signature: eurostep from the free-throw line, dunk

tim-duncan.signature: bank shot off glass, zero expression

hakeem-olajuwon.signature: Dream Shake into a baseline fade

bill-russell.signature: blocked shot kept in play to start the break

julius-erving.signature: rock-the-baby cradle dunk from the baseline

karl-malone.signature: pick-and-roll catch and flush from Stockton

dennis-rodman.signature: horizontal dive into the third row for a board

kevin-garnett.signature: turnaround from the post, screaming after

ray-allen.signature: corner three off a curl, perfect form

rick-barry.signature: underhand free throw, then a dagger jumper

walt-frazier.signature: pickpocket steal into a glide layup

willis-reed.signature: limping out of the tunnel, first bucket

bill-walton.signature: outlet pass like a quarterback, headband flying

george-gervin.signature: ice-cold finger roll from the foul line

isiah-thomas.signature: blur of a drive through the whole defense

clyde-drexler.signature: gliding windmill from the dotted line

reggie-miller.signature: eight points in nine seconds, choke sign

gary-payton.signature: full-court pressure into a steal, talking the whole way

tracy-mcgrady.signature: 13 points in 35 seconds energy, pull-up three

steve-nash.signature: dribbling under the rim, wraparound dime

chris-paul.signature: mid-range pull-up off the snake dribble

dwight-howard.signature: superman lob caught above the square

kawhi-leonard.signature: mid-range rise over two, dead silence

anthony-davis.signature: lob catch and block at the other end

nikola-jokic.signature: no-look over-the-shoulder dime from the post

joel-embiid.signature: dream shake into a three, airplane celebration

victor-wembanyama.signature: block at the rim, three at the other end

yao-ming.signature: soft turnaround over a helpless defender

elvin-hayes.signature: turnaround from the left block, automatic

wes-unseld.signature: chest-pass outlet that starts a layup

bob-mcadoo.signature: face-up jumper no big man should have

nate-archibald.signature: tiny blur leading the league in points and dimes

bernard-king.signature: catch-and-shoot in the blink of an eye

alex-english.signature: silky mid-range in the high altitude

connie-hawkins.signature: palming the ball on a swooping drive

paul-arizin.signature: line-drive jumper, first of its kind

ben-wallace.signature: weak-side block with the fro flying

chauncey-billups.signature: ice-water pull-up three in crunch time

jimmy-butler.signature: mid-post bully bucket and a stare

george-mikan.signature: drop-step hook that changed the rules

sam-jones.signature: bank shot off the high glass

spencer-haywood.signature: face-up four ahead of his time

sidney-moncrief.signature: lockdown stop then a baseline slam

tom-chambers.signature: rising over a defender's head for the poster

dan-majerle.signature: transition three from the parking lot

kevin-johnson.signature: baseline drive and dunk over the big

horace-grant.signature: goggles gleaming on a putback slam

brandon-roy.signature: crunch-time iso, hand in his face, bucket

rasheed-wallace.signature: ball don't lie — turnaround and a technical
